Mouth: rest

How the anchor stays fixed

The full generated variants are never used as whole frames. The preview blends them through the outlined eye, mouth and hair-tip masks. Anything outside these masks always comes from the base image. Hair roots above the masks remain fixed.

Animation starts only when you press Play. Reduced-motion preferences and hidden tabs pause it.

12 anchored mouth poses

Each shape comes from the full character, at the same position and scale. A/E/I keeps the earlier gentle open mouth unchanged. The automatic recognizer uses a smaller set; all 12 remain available for inspection.
